subject: Linguistics
title: Locution, Illocution, Perlocution
description: A quick win: understand Locution, Illocution, Perlocution.

hook.text: 'There's a bull in the field.' The words, the warning, and the panic—three different acts in one.

buildup.text: Austin identified three layers: locution (the words), illocution (the intent), perlocution (the effect).

discovery.text: Locution is what you say; illocution is what you mean to do; perlocution is what actually happens.

twist.text: Your illocution might be a warning, but the perlocution could be laughter if no one believes you.

climax.text: These three layers show that every utterance operates on multiple levels simultaneously.

punchline.text: Words, intentions, and effects—three acts in one sentence.

quiz.question: What is illocution?
options: The intended force behind an utterance
